subject: Weekly staff early-signal brief + QBR action items
messages:
From: sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly staff early-signal brief + QBR action items

Team —

Sharing a short early-signal brief ahead of tomorrow's QBR prep slot. This is intentionally slim — bullets only — with 3 asks at the bottom so leadership can triage quickly. Attached: QBR-focused_signals_v2.pdf (single-slide signal map + 1-pg ask list).

Wins
- Demo-to-PoC conversion with Acme progressed: legal sign-off expected this week; sales forecast +$180k ARR for Q3.
- Dedicated throughput improvements: serving runtime patch reduced p99 generation latency by ~10% on 8k context in internal canary.
- New Marketplace listing (partner integration) completed UAT; initial partner lead expected in next sprint.

Risks / Signals
- Capacity: a spike in large-context workloads from two enterprise customers is pushing token-per-req up 2.3x; current batching config increases tail latency for small interactive flows.
- QBR readiness: several product metrics (cold-start error rate and cache hit ratio) have weak telemetry for 30–90s prep windows — we need artifacts for SLAs.
- Procurement friction: GigaCloud contract timeline slipped — procurement now requests demo logs and SOC2 evidence.

Asks (please action or assign)
1) Laura: can you confirm we have the SOC2 summary and audit point person for GigaCloud by EOD? They want a named contact for vendor review.
2) Karthik: prioritize a short runbook (1 pager) for handling high-token spikes (routing/fallback policy + temporary scale steps). Can we have a draft by 11:00 PT?
3) Monica / Markus: for QBR slides, please call out the latency improvement and list three mitigations for capacity risk (owner + ETA). I attached the slide with placeholders.

Next steps: I'll be in the 10:30 QBR prep slot to walk through the slides and highlight the Acme & GigaCloud asks. If anyone needs the raw traces or the canary logs beforehand, reply and I'll share a Drive link.

Thanks —
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Attachment: QBR-focused_signals_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Sergio — thanks, concise and useful. Quick notes:

- I'll own the SOC2/Paperwork contact for GigaCloud. I'll introduce them to Priya (security lead) in the intro thread and confirm expected artifacts by EOD.
- Monica/Markus: please include a one-slide SOC2 evidence checklist in the QBR appendix — procurement will ask for it.
- Karthik: runbook by 11:00 PT works; if you need logs call out the time window you want and Hannah can spin a short trace dump.

Also: is the Acme forecast assumption conservative? If legal signs off this week, we should model a 60-day ramp rather than immediate recognition — don't want surprises in Q3 bookings.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
